units.source_text: 行幸日期渐渐迫近，舞乐正在试演。

en.t: The day of the imperial outing was gradually drawing near, and the court dances and music were being rehearsed.
Just then, Taifu no Myobu arrived.

units.source_text: 源氏公子见了她，想起对小姐很抱歉，便问：“她怎么样了？”

en.t: When Prince Genji saw her, he remembered how badly he had treated the young lady and asked, "How is she?"

units.source_text: 大辅命妇将小姐近况告诉了他，最后说：“你这样完全不把她放在心上，我们旁人看了心里也很难过！”

en.t: Taifu no Myobu told him how the young lady had been lately, and finally said, "When you pay her no mind at all like this, even those of us nearby feel deeply distressed to see it."
As she spoke, she was almost in tears.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“这命妇原教我适可而止，才能觉得小姐文雅可爱。

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "This Myobu had originally advised me to keep a proper restraint, so that I might find the young lady refined and lovable.

units.source_text: 而我竟做错了事，恐怕命妇会怪我轻举妄为吧！”

en.t: Yet I have gone and done the wrong thing; she will surely blame me for acting rashly."

units.source_text: 觉得在她面前无以为颜。

en.t: He felt he could hardly face her.

units.source_text: 又想象小姐本人默默无语而心怀悲恸的模样，觉得很可怜。

en.t: Then he imagined the young lady herself, silent and wordless while grieving in her heart, and he felt great pity for her.

units.source_text: 便叹口气说：“不得空闲，没有办法呀。”

en.t: So he sighed and said, "I simply have no free time; there is nothing I can do."

units.source_text: 又微笑着说：“这个人太不解情趣了，我想稍稍惩戒她一下呢。”

en.t: Then, smiling, he added, "She is far too unresponsive to romantic feeling, so I thought I would punish her just a little."

units.source_text: 看到他那年轻英俊的姿态，使得大辅命妇也不由得微笑了。

en.t: Seeing his youthful and handsome bearing, Taifu no Myobu could not help smiling too.

units.source_text: 她想：“像他那样青春年华，难免受女人们怨恨。

en.t: She thought, "At his youthful age, it is only natural that women should bear grudges against him.

units.source_text: 他思虑疏忽，任情而动，原也是不足怪的。”

en.t: That he is careless in his judgment and acts as his feelings lead him is, after all, not so strange."
